Class View.CardTilesView

java.lang.Object
Amphipolis.Javadoc.View.LabelWithImageAndText

Amphipolis.Javadoc.View.CardTilesView
Enclosing class:
View
public static class View.CardTilesView extends View.ButtonTilesView
Concrete implementation for Character Cards. Extends ButtonTilesView as cards are clickable, but adds special effects and distinct layout logic.

    • attach

      public void attach(JPanel panel)
      Attaches the card button to a standard JPanel. Overrides the parent method to simply add the button without layering if not needed. Pre-condition: panel is not null. Post-condition: The card button is added to the panel.
      Overrides:
      attach in class View.LabelWithImageAndText
      Parameters:
      panel - The target container.

    • update

      public void update()
      Updates the visual state of the card. Refreshes the icon and adjusts bounds (cards are larger than standard tiles). Post-condition: - Icon is reloaded. - Bounds are scaled (Width * 3, Height * 5). - Count label is re-positioned.
      Overrides:
      update in class View.LabelWithImageAndText

    • positionCountLabel

      public void positionCountLabel()
      specialized logic to position the status label relative to the larger card image. Post-condition: The count/status label is centered below the card image.
